verdict.rationale: Steel's own GitHub README states the browser uses Puppeteer and CDP and lets you connect with Puppeteer, Playwright, or Selenium. That directly covers pointing existing automation code at Steel's browsers rather than rewriting it. The evidence is a single first-party statement, though, without connection specifics. missing for 10: docs detailing the CDP/WebSocket connect endpoint and per-library connection examples, confirmation that this applies to the managed cloud sessions and not just the self-hosted browser, independent or hands-on corroboration of drop-in compatibility.
